metadata.title: Rotpunkt Kitchen AI Image Generator
metadata.description: Generate your dream kitchen with AI

notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.description: The requested page does not exist or has been moved.

intro.title: Choose a Starting Point
intro.description: Start with one of our curated templates or create your own combination. All settings can be adjusted afterwards.
intro.customDescription: Start with an empty selection and determine each step individually.

scandi.label: Scandi Interior
scandi.description: Bright oak textures, calm styling, and a soft daylight kitchen with island.
scandi.extraWishes: Floor-to-ceiling windows, thin matte worktop, linen textiles, and subtle black details.

luxury.label: Luxury Evening
luxury.description: A rich burgundy penthouse kitchen with polished marble and warm evening mood.
luxury.extraWishes: Architectural pendant lights, premium stone veining, brass highlights, and cinematic ambient glow.

urbanLoft.label: Urban Loft Contrast
urbanLoft.description: Black fronts, concrete base materials, and a bold metropolitan loft expression.
urbanLoft.extraWishes: Exposed structure, smoked glass details, curated objects, and directional accent lighting.

organicModern.label: Organic Modern
organicModern.description: Warm natural materials, handleless fronts, and a relaxed modern country-house feel.
organicModern.extraWishes: Open shelving moments, handcrafted ceramics, warm oak tones, and soft sunset reflections.

kind.label: Room Focus
kind.description: What type of room should be visualized? Choose the focus for the scene.

color.label: Colour World
color.description: Define the dominant colour scheme for furniture, doors and accents – choose from the  catalog or original FENIX® colour tones.

handle.label: Handles & Rails
handle.description: Select a handle/rail model and exactly one available color variant.

atmosphere.label: Atmosphere & Style
atmosphere.description: Define the visual atmosphere of your scene — style direction, camera perspective, and lighting mood.

style.label: Style Direction
style.description: Which interior style fits best? This selection determines lines and material mix.

environment.label: Category
environment.description: Choose the architectural context for your scene. The category sets proportions, spatial feel, and the material character of the visualization.

viewpoint.label: Perspective
viewpoint.description: Choose the camera perspective and focus for your visualization.

location.label: Location
location.description: Where is the property located? This option shapes lighting mood and view.

time.label: Time
time.description: Influences the lighting mood and shadow casting of the scene.

floor.label: Floor
floor.description: What flooring should be used in the scene?

accessories.label: Accessories & Decoration
accessories.description: Choose plants and decorative elements for the scene. Multiple selection possible.

houseType.label: Building
houseType.description: What architecture surrounds the room? Defines frame and exterior shell.

options.modernesHolzhaus: Modern Wooden House with Large Windows

hints.vielGlas: Lots of glass, cool color temperature

final.extraWishesDescription: Here you can enter additional details (e.g. "large kitchen island, lots of light")
